name: COVID-19, Netherlands
source: RIVM (cases, deaths); RIVM (wastewater); Our World in Data (vaccinations)
licence: Public Domain Mark 1.0; CC BY 4.0; CC BY 4.0
notes: Cases and deaths by date of publication by RIVM, not date of illness, so weekends and holidays show dips. Deaths stop on 2022-12-31 and cases on 2023-03-31. vaccinations is doses per day (7-day average); fully_vaccinated_pct is per 100 people, only on days it was reported; wastewater is SARS-CoV-2 particles per 100,000 people (national average, weekly since July 2025).
